title: Continuity of Gaussian bivariate stability
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$. For independent standard Gaussian random variables $X,Y$, define $S_\rho(\alpha,\beta)=\mathbb P\bigl(\Phi(X)\le\alpha,\ \Phi(\rho X+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\,Y)\le\beta\bigr)$, where $\Phi$ is the standard Gaussian distribution function. Then $S_\rho$ is continuous on $[0,1]^2$.
